title: Bongo Flava: The Sound of Modern Tanzania
excerpt: Bongo Flava is the popular music of modern Tanzania: a mix of hip-hop, R&B, taarab and local rhythms, sung in Swahili.
body:
## What is it?

Bongo Flava developed in the 1990s in Dar es Salaam ("Bongo" is a nickname for the city). It mixes hip-hop, R&B, reggae, taarab and local rhythms, mostly sung in Swahili.

## Artists

Tanzanian artists such as Diamond Platnumz and many others have become popular across East Africa and beyond.

## Where to hear it

Everywhere: on buses, in taxis, at bars and on the radio.

## Other styles

- **Taarab:** sung poetry with orchestra, especially on Zanzibar.
- **Singeli:** fast dance music from Dar es Salaam.

See [Sauti za Busara](/blog/sauti-za-busara-festival/).
